description: Blocks the orchestrator from running a long-running process inline: the `review` CLI, any `--watch` flag, a build/test suite (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun test|build, pytest/vitest/jest/cypress/playwright/unittest/tox, cargo/go test|build, make test|build|all — also behind a launcher that executes it: python -m pytest|unittest, uv run pytest, uvx, poetry/pipenv/pdm run, coverage run -m, npx/bunx, npm exec, pnpm exec|dlx, yarn exec|dlx|run, bun run|x), or `sleep N` with N>=10. Dispatch it to a BACKGROUND subagent instead. Argv-aware: the command is shell-tokenized and a long process is flagged only when the REAL invoked command (argv[0] after peeling inline env + no-op wrappers) is the runner — a keyword inside a quoted argument to a different command (tg/echo/git commit -m) never trips it; `sleep 2` passes. Subagent-exempt (agent_id present). Deny-by-default: no self-service bypass (ALLOW_INLINE_PROCESS env / `# inline-process-ok:` sentinel removed); a would-be BLOCK consults RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_NO_LONG_INLINE_PROCESS with a written justification, which asks Telegram via trusted tg-ctl and allows ONLY on an approval tap (a blank/bare 1 denies). timeout_ms 960000 covers tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus margin so a hung ask can't race the dispatcher's timeout kill into a silent on_error=open ALLOW; a CC settings entry launching cc_hook_bridge must set timeout >960s. on_error=open.
